source_title: NZXT Discount Codes: 50% Off in November 2026
source_excerpt:
NZXT has been a household name in the world of PC gaming for years now, thanks in part to its PC cases. The company’s cases are known for their clean and highly aesthetic design, marketed toward gamers who really care about how their system looks. That’s been NZXT’s jam, even as it has moved into other parts and peripherals in the PC gaming ecosystem. So, if you’re looking for an NZXT discount code or information on promos and deals, you’ve come to the right place.
Score 50% Off PCs With NZXT Discount Codes and Deals
NZXT has already changed the game with Flex , their subscription-based model for renting PCs that’s a more affordable way to get your hands on the latest tech. The idea is to serve gamers who might not be able to afford a PC gaming setup all at once. Instead, you’re put on a monthly NZXT subscription plan, starting at $59 a month.
You can also save up to $250 on the company’s daily deals . These include everything from PC cases to accessories. As we stated earlier, the company does far more than make PC cases these days. We recently reviewed the NZXT Relay Headset and Switchmix and found them to be a really innovative wired audio solution. The company’s affordable wired gaming mouse, the NZXT Lift 2 Symm, even made it onto our picks for the best gaming mice . Check back daily, as NZXT drops daily deals and special offers all the time.
Save up to $150 on Gaming Gear Bundles
The savings at NZXT pile up if you plan to spend a bit more. For example, you might want to tie a few of these products together into a Gaming Gear Bundle . These NZXT combo deals are the best way to save money by bundling your purchases together, giving you discounts up to as much as $150.
Enjoy Free Shipping on NZXT Gaming PCs
NZXT also offers free shipping on select NZXT gaming PCs and other products if your order totals $75 or more. That’s important to consider as you’re putting together your shopping cart, as it may be worth adding a cheaper peripheral or accessory just to save on shipping.
Unlock Exclusive Discounts With NZXT Club Rewards
For the true NZXT fans, the company has something called the NZXT Club . By signing up, you can unlock special offers and earn Pucci Points that can be redeemed for future discounts and exclusive perks that are only for NZXT Club members.
Get 10% Off Refurbished NZXT in 2026
Buying refurbished, like-new electronics is a great way to save money on major electronics purchases. NZXT makes it easy to save, with a dedicated online section of refurbished tech , including a refurbished custom build H9 (2023) gaming PC with an RTX 4060, regularly $3,238 but now only $2,650. There are many other great clearance deals, like a refurbished Player Three Prime H9 gaming PC with an RTX 4080 SUPER, regularly $3,249 but on sale for $2,800.
Don’t Miss Out: $50 Off if You Refer Your Friends
NZXT makes it even easier to save by rewarding you for purchases you were already planning to make. If you’re happy with the service and want others to try it, you can get a $50 discount when you refer a friend . When you share your referral link with friends, you can offer $50 off any Player PC, and when they buy an NZXT Gaming PC, you’ll get $60 off your next order.
